title: Shenzhen International Botanical Garden
description: Join a walkthrough of Shenzhen International Botanical Garden with Jiajian Qu. It is a sprawling 1,000-acre park blending global horticulture and architecture. Discover themed gardens from Hangzhou’s West Lake replicas to Japanese pavilions and French elegance. Unveil its history as a flower expo hub and Shenzhen’s multicultural spirit, proving the city is more than skyscrapers.
